title: Robust interpolation inequalities via Chebyshev-type integral inequalities
summary: We establish robust log-convex interpolation inequalities within the scale of Gagliardo seminorms. We achieve this by deriving some Chebyshev-type integral inequalities for general non-synchronous functions. Our primary motivation for establishing these robust interpolation inequalities stems from the study of the asymptotic nonlocal-to-local stability of weak solutions to the boundary Dirichlet problem associated with the regional fractional $p$-Laplacian.
